limitations: Exactly59 frozen prediction mixtures; classification averages continuous probabilities, regression averages accepted original numeric-Y predictions. No metric averaging was used to form a score.
The constituent metric mean/range are descriptive baselines only; every composite metric was computed once from its own frozen prediction CSV.
Same original Valid repeatedly used, including earlier model selection. No independent generalization or hidden-test/official score claim.
Four-seed groups add H10044/45 to RTX409046/47 and are fixed host/seed mixtures. Historical LD50/Sol two-seed H0 host differences also remain per constituent.
BBB H0 seed46 is excluded for missing encoder-after; no BBB-H0 composite or substitute.
AP remains tied-group average precision, official AUPRC equivalence unconfirmed; original numeric-label/units limitations retained.
No learned weights, threshold/rank transformation, best-seed exclusion, ensemble-of-winners, official aggregate or new fit/inference/encoding.
Counts summarize heterogeneous task directions and are not an overall benchmark score.
